title: Rebuild Notes Cleaner output action section (Copy/Clear + File Name + Download TXT) with reset & filename rules

requirements.text: Modify only the "Cleaned Notes" output panel in frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx to rebuild the action section layout as follows: (1) keep the existing Copy button directly below the "Cleaned Output" textarea, (2) add a new "Clear Output" button next to Copy (same row), (3) directly below that row render a "File Name" input with placeholder "Enter file name (optional)", and (4) directly below the File Name input render a "Download TXT" button. Ensure the layout is clean and responsive (stacking appropriately on small screens) and do not remove or change any existing formatting features/options.

quotes:
REBUILD CLEAN NOTES ACTION SECTION

Modify the Cleaned Notes panel only.

1. Below the "Cleaned Output" textarea:
   Keep the existing Copy button.

2. Directly below Copy button:
   Add a new button:
   Label: Download TXT

3. Above the Download button:
   Add an input field:
   Label: File Name
   Placeholder: Enter file name (optional)

4. Add another button next to Copy:
   Label: Clear Output

acceptanceCriteria: Only the output panel UI (the "Cleaned Notes" card content) is changed; no changes to the Rough Notes panel or formatting controls.
Below the "Cleaned Output" textarea, Copy remains present.
A "Clear Output" button labeled exactly "Clear Output" is placed next to Copy in the same row.
A "File Name" labeled input with placeholder "Enter file name (optional)" appears above the Download button in the output panel.
A "Download TXT" button labeled exactly "Download TXT" is placed below the Copy/Clear row (and below the File Name input).
On small screens, controls remain usable and do not overflow; layout is responsive.

requirements.text: Implement "Clear Output" behavior in frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: when clicked, completely clear the "Cleaned Output" textarea (cleanedNotes becomes empty), reset the File Name input value to empty, reset the Copy button state (so it is no longer in a "Copied!" state), and ensure the "Download TXT" button is hidden when the output is empty.

quotes:
A) Clear Output Button:
- Completely clear the Cleaned Output textarea.
- Hide Download TXT button if output is empty.
- Reset File Name input field.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Clear Output" empties the output textarea content immediately.
After clearing, the File Name input is reset to an empty string.
After clearing, any "Copied!" UI state is reset back to the normal Copy UI.
"Download TXT" is not visible when cleaned output is empty.

requirements.text: Implement auto-reset behavior when the "Clean Notes" button is clicked in frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: automatically clear any previous cleaned output and reset File Name and Copy state before displaying the newly formatted result, ensuring outputs do not stack/accumulate across runs.

quotes:
B) Auto Reset Logic:
- When Clean Notes button is clicked:
   → Automatically clear previous Cleaned Output
   → Then show new formatted result
- Do not stack outputs.

acceptanceCriteria: When "Clean Notes" is clicked, any prior cleaned output is cleared before the new result is shown (no stacked/concatenated output).
File Name input is reset on each run of "Clean Notes".
Copy state is reset on each run of "Clean Notes".
The existing note formatting behavior (bullets/paragraph-to-points/definition style/heading detection) remains unchanged.

requirements.text: Update TXT download logic to match the requested naming rules while preserving plain-text export: in frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownload.ts, when the File Name input is empty, generate the filename using the format notes_<first_word_of_output>_<current_date>.txt where <current_date> is YYYY-MM-DD. The <first_word_of_output> must come from the cleaned output text (ignoring leading whitespace and common bullet prefixes like "- ", "• ", "* "), sanitized for filenames (lowercase, spaces to underscores, remove non [a-z0-9_], collapse underscores). When a custom name is provided, use it and ensure it ends with .txt. The downloaded file must contain exactly the cleaned output as plain text, preserving spacing/newlines and containing no HTML tags.

quotes:
C) Download TXT Logic:
- When clicked:
   → Generate a plain .txt file.
   → Preserve formatting and spacing.
   → No HTML tags.

File Naming Rules:
- If user enters custom name → use that.
- If empty:
   Use format:
   notes_<first_word_of_output>_<current_date>.txt

Date format:
YYYY-MM-DD

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Download TXT" downloads a .txt file whose contents exactly match the "Cleaned Output" textarea value (including whitespace and newlines) and contains no HTML markup.
If the File Name input has a value, that value is used as the base filename and .txt is appended if missing.
If the File Name input is empty, the filename is notes_<first_word_of_output>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.txt.

The <first_word_of_output> is derived from the cleaned output text (ignoring leading whitespace and common bullet prefixes) and sanitized for filenames (lowercase, underscores, stripped special characters).
The date in the filename uses the current client date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

constraints: Modify the Cleaned Notes panel only (frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx output section); do not change other panels or unrelated UI.
Do not remove or alter existing notes formatting features/logic (e.g., bullet conversion, paragraph-to-points, definition style, heading detection).
Hide the "Download TXT" button when cleaned output is empty.
Keep user-facing text in English and match the exact labels/placeholders specified: "Download TXT", "Clear Output", "File Name", "Enter file name (optional)".
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths; compose existing UI components only.
nonGoals: Adding new backend endpoints or persisting notes/output to the backend.
Changing the notes cleaning/formatting algorithm in frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts.
Adding new export formats (PDF/DOCX) or changing any other pages/modules.
